title: Give CI a test limit that catches only a stuck test
body:
## Summary

CI's test step now selects a new nextest profile, `ci`, which inherits everything from `default` except the per-test limit. A local `scripts/check test`, an agent's included, keeps the 8s budget.

```diff
 # .config/nextest.toml
 [profile.default]
 slow-timeout = { period = "8s", terminate-after = 1 }   # unchanged: local budget, only comes down
 global-timeout = "5m"
 ...
+[profile.ci]                                             # selected only by CI's test step
+slow-timeout = { period = "30s", terminate-after = 2 }  # named at 30s, killed at 60s
```

```diff
 # .github/workflows/ci.yml, test job
       - run: scripts/check test
+        env:
+          NEXTEST_PROFILE: ci
```

`scripts/check` is unchanged. It passes no `--profile`, so the `nextest list` override check and `nextest run` both take the profile from `NEXTEST_PROFILE`. Any `[[profile.default.overrides]]` exception applies under `ci` as well. CI is chosen through the workflow and not through the `CI` variable, because an operator may set `CI=true` in an agent session's `session-env`.

## Evidence

- **Before:** in #855, `test (ubuntu-latest)` failed on two `deliveries::` tests the PR didn't touch. They were killed at 8s, and under CPU load the same happened on `main`.
  **After:** nextest picks up the profile from the variable:
  ```text
  $ NEXTEST_PROFILE=ci cargo nextest run ...
   Nextest run ID … with nextest profile: ci
  $ NEXTEST_PROFILE=ci scripts/check test
  ok: test (97s)
  $ scripts/check test           # default profile, 8s budget
  ok: test (21s)
  $ scripts/check                # every CI check
  ok: fmt markdown compose css clippy test doc
  ```
  These runs did not include a test that hangs past 60s, so the kill at 60s comes from the config and was not exercised.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

The change is one config profile and one workflow `env` entry. Removing them reverts it.

**Blast Radius:** CI

In CI only, a test that takes 8–60s now passes where it used to fail. A slow test that a change introduces is still caught locally by the 8s budget. A stuck test in CI is now killed at 60s instead of 8s, which is still well inside the 5-minute `global-timeout`.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Closes #861
